dimensions.title: Cognitive
activities: Play board games that require counting
Engage in guessing games
Encourage problem-solving with building blocks
watchFor: Shows limited understanding of cause and effect

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Understands and uses vocabulary of 2,000 words
activities: Read books together and ask questions
Encourage storytelling with props
Play rhyming games to increase vocabulary

dimensions.title: Physical
activities: Engage in outdoor play like running and jumping
Practice fine motor skills with arts and crafts
Set up obstacle courses to enhance coordination
watchFor: Clumsiness that affects feeding or dressing
Lack of interest in physical play

dimensions.title: Social
activities: Arrange playdates with peers
Participate in group activities or team sports
Encourage role-playing games

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Begins to understand the concept of fairness
activities: Discuss emotions and feelings during story time
Role-play different scenarios to explore emotions
Encourage emotional expression through art
watchFor: Difficulty calming down after being upset

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Asks many questions about the world
activities: Visit museums or nature centers
Conduct simple science experiments at home
Encourage exploration in the backyard or neighborhood
watchFor: Reluctance to engage in new activities

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on a task for 10-15 minutes
Shows curiosity about learning new things
activities: Provide activities that require multi-step processes
Create a daily learning routine
Incorporate learning into play
watchFor: Shows no interest in learning new skills

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can help with simple household tasks
activities: Assign age-appropriate chores
Encourage self-serving during meals
Allow choices in daily activities
watchFor: Reluctance to engage in self-care tasks
Relying heavily on adults for guidance
